findings.reason: a coordinator following the recorded order would land and deploy §5/§6 without §10 and crash-loop the ingest, which is the exact failure §10 was written to prevent.
findings.text: `s10` declares that it gates the deployment ("it does not restart onto §5 before §10 lands") but no gate relationship is recorded: `plan-section-depends-on` lists only `s10:[s6]`, and the open dispatch followup `f-wil-001` orders §3, §4, §8, §5, §6, §7 with no mention of §10

findings.reason: the node's gate would fail on files it is fenced out of, so as written the measure is unsatisfiable and the worker must either fail the gate or write outside its scope.
findings.text: the done-when "A search of the repository for `--output=` finds no relative or repository-root target" cannot hold within the declared write scope: seven relative or repository-root writers lie outside it — `scripts/_disc_regate.sh:7`, `scripts/_disc_regate2.sh:7`, `scripts/_d3_arm.sh:7`, `scripts/_r2_fix_cycle.sh:10`, `scripts/_r2_pipeline.sh:10`, `scripts/slurm/excited_cohort_scan.sbatch:14`, `scripts/slurm/_m1_run_suite.sh:7` — while the scope names only `imas_ambix/data/cli.py:663`, `scripts/spine_label_fleet.sh:7`, `scripts/temporal_operator_cycle.sh:10` and `scripts/run_magnetics_era_scorecard.sbatch:7`

findings.reason: that count is the plan's own evidence for its write scope, and understating it by seven is what leaves the section's repository-wide done-when impossible.
findings.text: the body states "Four other writers name a relative or repository-root output and move to the same directory", but a search of `imas_ambix/` and `scripts/` for a `#SBATCH --output=` target that is relative or repository-root returns eleven files, so the plan plans for four of eleven
